uptime_target: 99% monthly per service (measured by external probe, see probe feed)
schema_policy: No breaking schema changes without a new versioned resource. Response envelopes {ok, niche, result, receipt} are stable; new fields are additive only. Deprecations announced >= 30 days in llms.txt and the 402 body.
delivery_policy: If a paid result cannot be produced, the call returns 402 and is NOT settled (you are not charged). Delivery happens only after x402 settlement succeeds on Base.
notes: Best-effort SLA for machine consumers; no monetary penalties. Measured, not promised.
